entry.title: Wreck 0.1.2
entry.summary: Wreck 0.1.2: a sound design instrument for the Akai Force / MPC OS (VST2, ARMv7). Install: unzip and follow INSTALL.md inside (needs MPC OS 3.x). Copy your own .wav files into /sdcard/Synths/L'Cronx - VST - Wreck/data/wav, then open the SAMPLES page and tap RESCAN. Knobs now use the 126 px, 128-frame picture format other Force plugins run on, to stop the knob picture sliding out of its window. Status: Working on Force (knob display, SAMPLES page). See docs/UNVERIFIED.md
